meta.name: failure-taxonomy
meta.description: Classifying AI failures — hallucination, refusal, irrelevance, tone mismatch, latency.

copy.tagline: 分类AI输出中的各类失败模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化识别和归类AI输出的错误类型
copy.tagline_en: Classify failure modes in AI outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically identify and categorize errors in AI outputs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 学会识别 AI 输出的失败类型，包括幻觉、拒绝回答、语气不当、延迟等，并评估严重等级（致命/高/中/低），用于记录和优先处理。
howto.when: 当你指出或询问 AI 输出的问题，例如“这个回答有错误”或“为什么回答得这么慢”。

say.text: 分析这段回答的失败类型是什么？
say.note: Claude 会归类并说明严重等级。

say.text: 判断这句话是否有幻觉？
say.note: Claude 会指出是否幻觉及原因。

say.text: 这个回答的语气合适吗？
say.note: Claude 会识别语气不当等问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude learns to classify AI output failures into types like hallucination, refusal, tone mismatch, latency, etc., and assess severity (critical/high/medium/low) for logging and prioritization.
howto.when_en: When you point out or ask about issues in AI output, e.g., "This answer has errors" or "Why is it so slow?".

say_en.text: Classify the failure type in this response.
say_en.note: Claude will categorize and give severity.
Claude will indicate yes/no and why.
